title: Kirk McConnell and extended electrodynamics
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee, Washington DC

tellings.quote: So he's Senate Armed Services Committee and he was under Jack Reid um the senator from Rhode Island and he knows all about extended electronamics

plain: A staffer on the Senate Armed Services Committee named Kurt McConnell, who worked under Jack Reed, the senator from Rhode Island, is said to know all about extended electrodynamics, a proposed broadening of the physics of electricity and magnetism. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that people close to Congress follow unusual physics that might explain how strange craft move.
